description.value: Kanpai Asian Eatery & Bar is an Asian restaurant and bar located on Blanshard Street in downtown Victoria. OSM records it as open Friday and Saturday evenings only, suggesting a focused dinner-and-drinks format rather than an all-day café. Very little public information was retrievable during review, as the business's Facebook page was inaccessible.
